title: Programmable synthesis of alkaloidal frameworks integrating Michael acceptor generates covalent probes for targeting POLE3 in HBV replication
content:

Nobuto Kaneko, Misao Himeno, Yuhi Kobayashi, Ryo Tanifuji, Hiroki Kubota, Haruki Mizoguchi, Makoto Muroi, Takehiro Suzuki, Masaya Sugiyama, Naoshi Dohmae, Hiroyuki Osada, Taketomo Kido, Atsushi Miyajima, Hiroki Oguri
A one-pot programmable synthesis of six alkaloidal Michael acceptors enables covalent targeting of POLE3 at Cys51, suppressing HBV replication by reducing HBsAg, rcDNA, and cccDNA levels.
